scientific_integrity: An exact paper-and-pencil consequence of stated published inequalities; the optional finite-vector enumerator is corroborative. No geometric examples or independent external evaluation are claimed.
scientific_limitations: Necessary upper bound only for pure unions of distinct smooth complex conics with A1, A3, D4, A5 and A7 singularities. Does not establish existence at five or six components, or extend to other singularities, singular components, or mixed arrangements. The proof uses published Dimca--Sernesi/Pokora and Zielinski bounds; possible unindexed earlier equivalent deduction remains a priority risk.
title: A six-component ceiling for nearly free smooth-conic arrangements with \(A_1,A_3,D_4,A_5,A_7\) singularities
